body: research/TASK_M5.md. Top tier, effort medium, Fast off. R38 landed today, so the decision stamp family you designed blind in M4 now has real states behind it - unanimous, majority, split and the three draws. Two new things to draw: the disagreement mark (which rounds the judges split on) and the swing round. Note the federations have ONE judge - that layout is a first-class state, not a three-column grid with two columns missing. No judge is ever named.
